plain: An officer who grants permission or a license.

webster.text: One who grants permission; a person authorized to grant permission to others; as a licenser of the press.

example.quote: Under such a government as this, an exemption of the press from previous restraint by licensers appointed by the king, is all the freedom that can be secured to it.
example.cite: James Madison, Report on the Virginia Resolutions (Report of 1800), Jan. 7, 1800
